Title: Jump And Run For Brainrot
Description:
Run and Jump for Brainrot is a fast-paced game where your goal is to collect Brainrot memes and grow stronger.

Jump across platforms to gather Brainrot, bring it back to your base, and power up. Level up to jump higher and reach even more challenging areas.
Instructions:
Desktop
WASD / Arrow Keys = Move the character
Right Mouse Button (hold and drag) = Rotate the camera
Spacebar = Jump
Left Mouse Button = Attack
Q = Drop Brainrot
E = Take Brainrot
R = Back to base
Z = Rebirth
P = Settings
Tab = Slow mode

Mobile
Left joystick = Move the character
Swipe on the right side of the screen = Rotate the camera
Jump button = Jump
Attack button = Attack
Drop button = Drop Brainrot
Take button = Take Brainrot

Title: Rough Ball
Description: Rough Ball is an addictive and challenging physics-based platformer where you control a cheeky smiley ball on a dangerous journey through rocky caves. Your goal is simple but tricky: roll, bounce, and slide carefully to reach the red flag without falling into the deadly pits. With slippery slopes, tricky jumps, and cute skull warnings, every level tests your precision and timing in this fun "do not fall" adventure!
Instructions:
Don’t Fall Down!
Step into the world of Rough Ball, an addictive and challenging physics-based platformer. Control a cheeky smiley ball through dangerous rocky caves. Your main goal is to roll, bounce, and slide carefully to reach the red flag without falling into deadly pits. Master slippery slopes and tricky jumps to win each level in this fun “do not fall” adventure!
Desktop Controls:
← (Left Arrow): Roll left
→ (Right Arrow): Roll right
Spacebar: Jump
Mobile Controls:
On-Screen Joystick: Drag to roll the ball left or right
Tap Jump Button: Tap to make the ball jump
